inputs.rule: fold round = 28 + 1 GET per new manifest + 1 GET per new ref log record (3 per insert); a Deferred round = 18; blob objects add no request
inputs.replaces: gc-scale.objects-30k if it fails: 30k (444 ref log records) lies past the 256-record snapshot threshold, where objects-100k (1479 records) measured 3689 fold requests against the linear 1 + 3 per part; 5k (75 records) lies inside the fitted regime

source_refs.claim: SYSTEM CAS GC RUN runs one synchronous round
a round with no changed shard and no due graduation is Deferred: no fold
each ref transaction appends one immutable _log object (create-only PUT)
a round that acquires the lease pulses once more
one pulse is a GET of gc/hb and one conditional PUT
a _snap snapshot is published after more than 256 log records or 1 MiB of tail
